Canonical alignment method registry

Source: R/alignment_registry.R
alignment_method_registry.Rd

Returns the machine-readable source of truth for public alignment methods. Registry records distinguish supplied graphs from feature-derived topology and metric-measure geometry; describe topology, node-data, supervision, output, complexity, dependency, and scale contracts; and embed lifecycle metadata validated by [validate_alignment_lifecycle()].

Usage

alignment_method_registry()

alignment_method_info(method, registry = alignment_method_registry())

alignment_method_table(registry = alignment_method_registry())

validate_alignment_method_registry(registry = alignment_method_registry())

Arguments

method

One canonical ID, exported entry point, adapter name, or benchmark alias.

registry

A registry returned by `alignment_method_registry()`.

Value

`alignment_method_registry()` returns a named list with class `alignment_method_registry`. `alignment_method_info()` returns one record. `alignment_method_table()` returns a data frame. `validate_alignment_method_registry()` returns an `alignment_registry_problems` data frame; zero rows means valid.

Details

`alignment_method_info()` resolves a canonical method ID, exported entry point, adapter name, or benchmark alias to exactly one record. `alignment_method_table()` returns a flattened data frame suitable for documentation and audits. `validate_alignment_method_registry()` returns typed schema and contradiction problems.

Examples

registry <- alignment_method_registry()
rapid <- alignment_method_info("rapid_ma", registry)
rapid$topology$supplied
#> [1] "native"
alignment_method_table(registry)[, c("id", "lifecycle", "primary_input")]
